plan.title: Withdraw Live RFQ with Special-Character Reason

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with a vendor bid on the buyer side.
Enable eRFX projects required for the RFQ event.
Match the case configuration for RFQ counter-offer visibility.
Match the case configuration while the RFQ is live and bidding remains open.
Apply the requested buyer bid-edit configuration.
Apply the requested percentage counter-offer configuration.
Withdraw the live RFQ stage and enter the exact special-character reason.
Assert that the RFQ stage is recorded as Withdrawn.
